rows.quote: On-site PC and mobile calibration combined with multi-step factory calibration tunes the whole screen of LED displays to uniform brightness and colour. Colour Expert LED Mobile provides a quick and easy calibration, requiring nothing more than a mobile phone and a Wi-Fi connection.

rows.quote: IFR series features multiple operational safeguards intended to minimize screen failures including embedded dual power units as well as forward and reverse signal redundancy.

reviews.reason: LH025IFRCLS/EN(2.5mm) 페이지의 Specifications 표 값을 해당 모델 값으로 추출함. HDR, 설치, 캘리브레이션, 동기화, 이중화 행은 IFR 시리즈 공통 기능 설명에 근거함. 'IF015R model does not support pivot functionality'는 다른 모델(IF015R)에 대한 예외라 넣지 않음. URL에는 '2400nit'가 있지만 사양 표의 Brightness는 1000nit라서 표 값을 씀.
